# site-test-02

> A neighbourhood sourdough bakery and cafe in Leeds serving fresh loaves, seasonal pastries, weekend brunch and custom celebration cakes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rajivjha1998.github.io/site-test-02/): Sourdough loaves, seasonal pastries, weekend brunch and custom celebration cakes from your neighbourhood bakery and cafe on Mill Lane, Leeds.
- [About](https://rajivjha1998.github.io/site-test-02/about/): Meet the neighbourhood sourdough bakery and cafe on Mill Lane, Leeds, baking for local families and office workers.
- [Contact](https://rajivjha1998.github.io/site-test-02/contact/): Book a call with our Leeds sourdough bakery and cafe. Email, phone, address and opening hours for 12 Mill Lane, Leeds LS1 4AB.
